messages.subject: Fixing a CRAN package
parts:
Hi,

I have some GNU-R code relying on the XML package that I want to be able to run in Renjin. I noticed that there is some problems building the package  in http://packages.renjin.org/package/org.renjin.cran/XML which indicates that there are some problems with the pom for this package. There is a link to the read only mirror on the packages page but that does not contain the pom file for building it. What would be the right way way to approach this? 

Best regards,
Per
